data.name: Advanced Weaponmaster Path
data.description: When using the Weaponmaster trance, you gain a +%1 competence bonus to damage rolls made with a weapon.  In addition, when using the Weaponmaster maneuver, you can choose to make a free disarm attempt against your attacker in place of the single melee attack.  If the disarm is successful, you may then make a single melee attack against your opponent in place of the 5-foot step.|AdvancedWeaponmasterPathBonus
prerequisites: PREABILITY:1,CATEGORY=Special Ability,Weaponmaster Path ~ First,Weaponmaster Path ~ Second
